w2:textbox.label: Upload to GridView after Removing Whitespace

1. Confirm that the Country column data in the GridView has leading and trailing spaces.
(options.trim=“true”)
2-1. Click the first button.
2-2. Open the downloaded Excel file.
2-3. Confirm the cell data in the Country column of the Excel file.
2-4. Confirm that leading and trailing spaces in the data have been removed.

(options.trim=“false”)
3-1. Click the second button.
3-2. Open the downloaded Excel file.
3-3. Confirm the cell data in the Country column of the Excel file.
3-4. Confirm that leading and trailing spaces in the data are preserved.

/// Sample Code (1)

var options = {
   trim: true
};
gridView1.advancedExcelDownload(options);

/// Sample Code (2)

var options = {
   trim: false
};
gridView1.advancedExcelDownload(options);
